Wenatchee Valley Velo Saturday Ride

Wenatchee, WA · Downtown · Road

Wenatchee Valley Velo Saturday Ride is a road group ride in Wenatchee, WA. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Wenatchee Valley Brewing Company. Pace: a/B/C groups (A 19+ mph, B 15–18, C 12–14).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a/B/C groups (A 19+ mph, B 15–18, C 12–14). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wenatchee Valley Velo Saturday Ride group ride

The Wenatchee Valley Velo club's weekly Saturday road ride, usually rolling from Wenatchee Valley Brewing Company. Rides are rated A, B or C by pace and by terrain. Exact times and routes are posted on the club's events calendar. The club also puts on some weeknight rides in season.
